The '''Gungan Sentry Post''' was a [[sentry tower]] located in one of the plains of the<ref name="TPM" /> [[Mid Rim Territories]]<ref name="SWTMap">{{GalaxyMapPoster}}</ref> [[planet]] [[Naboo]]. It consisted of the head of a statue<ref name="TPM" /> of the ancient [[Elders (Naboo)|Elders]] of Naboo.<ref name="CL2016">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> In [[32 BBY]],<ref name="TPMDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the [[Invasion of Naboo]] to [[32 BBY]].</ref> in anticipation for the [[Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation]], the alliance between the [[Homeworld|native]] [[Gungan]]s, [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]] people, and the [[Jedi Order]] was stationed around the Gungan Sentry Post. One [[militiagung]] of the [[Gungan Grand Army]] used a [[farseein]] to scout out the incoming invasion force, and upon gaining view of the [[Trade Federation Droid Army]], the Gungan notified the [[Youngling|young]] boy [[Anakin Skywalker]]. Skywalker in turn notified the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces]], and the group then began devising their battle plan.<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gungan Sentry Post first appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> It was first identified in [[2016]] by the [[Star Wars video games|mobile app]] ''[[Star Wars: Card Trader]]''.<ref name="Locations-Naboo" />
